changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from ClimMob v2 records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Bread wheat tricot trial in Samastipur (Bihar), rabi 2015-16
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of bread wheat varieties in Samastipur (Bihar), rabi 2015-16 season. Each participant ranked three varieties for several traits at the end of the season. ClimMob v2 export. Bread wheat trials in India were analysed in van Etten, J., de Sousa, K., Aguilar, A., et al. (2019). Crop variety management for climate adaptation supported by citizen science. PNAS 116(10), 4194-4199. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1813720116

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
location_privacy.gap_filling: Sites without a point take the mean of located sites with the same administrative names, pooled across all published trials (adm2+adm3, then adm3, then adm2, within 30 km of their mean), before rounding. coordinate_source names the level, coordinate_uncertainty_m adds the spread of the pool.

genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Early sowing, resistant to high temperature at seedling stage

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Wetsern Plain Zone -Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Rajasthan, Western Uttar Pradesh, parts of J & K (Jammu & Kathua Distt.) and parts of H.P. (Paonta Valley & Una Distt.)
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Bold seed. Leaf & yellow rust resistance

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Eastern Plain Zone (Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, Sikkim, West Bengal, Assam and Plains of far Eastern States)
genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Double dwarf (98.2 cm) with medium early maturity
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Greater stability against all the three rusts and more especially against leaf rust and leaf blight

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Eastern Plain Zone (Eastern Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Orissa, West Bengal, Sikkim and Plains of far Eastern states)
genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Plasticity to delayed sowings making it suitable for rice-wheat cropping system
genotypes.biotic_resistance: Tolerant to rusts and leaf blight

genotypes.recommended_zone: North Western and North Eastern Plain Zone
genotypes.biotic_resistance: It possesses very high adult plant resistance against most prevalent leaf rust disease as well as of 78S84 and 46S119 two most virulent races of yellow rust disease. It has also better degree of resistance against leaf blight
The variety possesses the usable and most practical type of disease resistance viz., the adult plant resistance (APR) because of Lr13
genotypes.remarks: Average seed yield is 35-40 q/ ha

genotypes.recommended_zone: Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Western Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan(Except Kota and Udaipur Divisions), foothills of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu& Kashmir and Uttarakhand
genotypes.maturity_abiotic_tolerance: Heat tolerant, water stagnation tolerant and lodging tolerant
genotypes.biotic_resistance: tolerant to leaf blight, susceptible to brown rust

genotypes.recommended_zone: Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Rajasthan (excluding kota & udaipur), Western Uttar Pradesh, Tarai of Uttarakhand and parts of H.P. (Paonta Valley & Una Distt.)
Eastern UP onwards upto the Far eastern states viz., Bihar, Orissa, West Bengal, Assam & Plains of NE region

Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
